name: When should I consider hiring a luxury property transaction coordinator?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider hiring a luxury property transaction coordinator?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider hiring a luxury property transaction coordinator as soon as your luxury property is under contract or you are preparing to make an offer. Their involvement from the outset ensures all pre-contract due diligence, disclosures, and initial paperwork are correctly handled, setting a strong foundation for the entire transaction. This early engagement is particularly beneficial for complex deals in competitive markets like Aventura or Miami Beach, where quick and accurate processing of documents can be a critical advantage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider hiring a luxury property transaction coordinator once your luxury property is under contract or when preparing an offer to ensure all early-stage documentation is managed correctly.
